body.p: 35-year-old woman with Hashimoto thyroiditis, here for follow-up. Reports fatigue and cold intolerance for six weeks; weight up 4 lb. Denies palpitations. Yuki says her partner Jordan noticed she has been sleeping 10 hours a night. Mother has Graves disease. Missed about two doses of Levothyroxine a week.

Hashimoto thyroiditis, under-replaced. Increase Levothyroxine from 75 mcg to 88 mcg daily, taken on an empty stomach. Recheck TSH in 6 weeks. Vitamin D 2000 IU daily to continue. Call 415-555-0100 with questions.
